rows.note: This is the everyday insulting noun for an unpleasant, rude or annoying person.

example.english: He’s such a prick, always barking at people.
example.traditional: 佢真係個仆街，成日對人呼呼喝喝。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 puk1 gaai1 seng4 jat6 deoi3 jan4 fu1 fu1 hot3 hot3

rows.note: Use this vulgar noun when “prick” refers directly to a penis.

example.english: When he was drunk, he actually showed everyone his prick.
example.traditional: 佢醉酒嗰陣竟然攞條𨳒出嚟畀人睇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zeoi3 zau2 go2 zan6 ging2 jin4 lo2 tiu4 diu2 ceot1 lai4 bei2 jan4 tai2

rows.note: Use this for the brief sharp pain or prick from a needle or similar sharp point.

example.english: The needle prick hurt briefly, then it was fine.
example.traditional: 打針嗰下針拮，痛一痛就冇事喇。
example.jyutping: daa2 zam1 go2 haa5 zam1 git3 tung3 jat1 tung3 zau6 mou5 si6 laa3
